title: ISRO Carried Rocket Parts on a Bicycle
description:
In ISRO's early days, rocket parts were carried to the launch site on a bicycle. A famous photo also shows a satellite moved on a bullock cart. Today India sends missions to the Moon and Mars.

#Shorts #ISRO #SpaceFacts
comment_prompt: Bicycle or bullock cart? Pick one
